panel.title: # <a:Arrow_Red:1354392969251127326>  VIOLATE GAMINGZ — TICKET SUPPORT
panel.description:
Need help? Open a ticket and select the category that best matches your request.

__**<a:hyper_staff:1494202473340993588>  GENERAL SUPPORT**__

For general questions, server issues, technical problems, or any other assistance related to VIOLATE GAMINGZ.

__**<a:alert:1507979606429536327>  REPORT PLAYER**__

Found a player breaking the rules? Open a ticket and provide their username, reason, and valid proof/evidence so our staff can review the report.

__**<a:red_check:1419741525847310336>  PARTNERSHIP**__

Interested in partnering with VIOLATE GAMINGZ? Open a ticket to discuss partnership opportunities, requirements, and collaborations.

__**<a:ustawienia:1507979590801424465>  STAFF APPLICATION**__

Want to join the VIOLATE GAMINGZ staff team? Open a ticket to apply and provide the required information.

«<:emoji_41:1507951442214785055>  Please select the correct category and provide clear information so our staff can assist you efficiently.»
